details: Provided mentoring to students on implementation and troubleshooting by leveraging a strong comprehension of web development frameworks and server-side technologies
Demonstrated knowledge of web technologies and frameworks, and advised on best practices for web design, including responsive layout creation and accessibility implementation

Exhibited proficiency in conveying intricate concepts related to C++ and OOP, such as encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism, to students with diverse levels of prior experience, resulting in effective communication

Assisted in planning and executing large-scale academic and extracurricular events, including the National Olympiad in Informatics (NOI), annual drama festivals, and the Guangzhou No.2 High School Group Sports Festival
Coordinated logistics, scheduling, and on-site operations for events involving over 3,000 participants, ensuring smooth execution and positive attendee experience
Supported event promotion, participant registration, and on-site coordination, contributing to increased student engagement and participation rates
